results.title: I’m Game Worldwide Box Office Collection Day 9: Beats Khalifa & Thudakkam To Become Mollywood’s 7th Highest-Grosser Of 2026
results.description: Dulquer Salmaan's fantasy thriller I'm Game has reached a global gross of 46.34 crore after nine days, officially becoming the seventh highest-grossing Mollywood film of 2026 by overtaking Khalifa and Thudakkam. The post I’m Game Worldwide Box Office Collection Day 9: Beats Khalifa & Thudakkam To Become Mollywood’s 7th Highest-Grosser Of 2026 appeared first on newsdio.com .
